verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation covers terminal appearance settings. Community remarks only indirectly suggest that color themes exist ("a few nice colours") and that font options are limited, since a user could not add custom fonts. The cursor docs cover moving the cursor on mobile, not styling it, and the generic sync claims never mention appearance settings. Missing for 10: documented font selection, color scheme and theme customization docs, cursor style or blink options, explicit persistence or sync of appearance settings, custom font support.
